out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: raw pork (48 F) (>4hrs), raw beef (54 F) (>4hr), 5 packaged raw beef (48 F) (>4hr), cut watermelon (47 F) (>4hr), tofu (51 F) (3hr), raw chicken (51 F) (3hr), pooled raw egg (46 F) (3hr), cooked rice (53 F) (3hr), raw fish (50 F) (<4hr) in the walk in cooler (1); Raw pork (52 F) (2hr) in the two door prep/cooler (2); cooked chicken (58 F) (2hr), cooked shrimp (48 F) (2hr), tofu (49 F) (2hr) in three door prep/cooler (3); raw chicken (50 F) (2hr), tofu (51 F) (2hr), cut cabbage (50 F) (2hr), raw beef (54 F) (2hr)in two door flat top RIC (4).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: TCS from the walk in cooler and coolers that were held out of temperature for over 4hrs were discarded, and TCS foods that were held out of temperature for under 4hrs were relocated to freezers.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: raw shrimp in a container of ice in the ware-wash area.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: PIC re-located the container of shrimp.

violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Person in charge took the in use spoon down from fire suppression nozzle.
